pretreatments.description: 2% KOH pretreatment: Mixing ZS with 2% KOH solution, setting moisture content to 95%, storing at room temperature for 24 h.
4% NaOH pretreatment: Mixing ZS with 4% NaOH solution, setting moisture content to 95%, storing at room temperature for 24 h.
4% AHP pretreatment: Adjusting the pH value of AHP solution to 11.5 by adding NaOH, mixing ZS with 4% AHP solution, setting moisture content to 95%, storing at room temperature for 24 h.
